[24], [25]  Particulate matter (PM), sulfur dioxide (SO ), and nitrogen oxide (NOx) limits were set by 2 the February 2013 update to the New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) for all technologies. [25], [26] The regulations differentiate between low rank and non-low rank coal types based on their heating value. Coals with an HHV of greater than 19,300 kJ/kg (8,300 Btu/lb) on a moist, mineral-matter free basis are considered non-low rank.
